summary: Stellus Private Credit BDC filed an 8-K to disclose the entry into a new investment advisory agreement with Stellus Private BDC Advisor, LLC effective June 22, 2026, following shareholder approval on June 16, 2026. The new agreement, triggered by a change in control of the advisor due to Ridgepost Capital, LLC's acquisition of Stellus Capital Management, LLC, has terms identical to the prior agreement, including fee structures. The two-year initial term renews annually subject to board or shareholder approval. While this involves an advisory agreement change, it does not represent a conventional special situation like a merger or acquisition of the registrant's shares. The filing is a routine regulatory requirement for investment companies under the 1940 Act. Watch for Ridgepost Capital's filings for further details on the advisor change.
